description: Start signing in to Amazon Alexa (or re-connect a revoked session). Returns a signInUrl on www.amazon.com and a loginId. Give the user the link to open in their OWN browser (a private tab works best on a phone with the Alexa app). After signing in they land on a blank www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding page: ask them to paste that page’s full address, then call alexa_finish_login with it and the loginId. The password never passes through this server. The link works for 15 minutes.
name: alexa_begin_login
